rules.description: insights at-a-glance: space for substance, not 2-3 sentences
stock: Keep each section to 2-3 not-too-long sentences. Don't overwhelm the user. Don't mention specific numerical stats or underlined_categories from the session data below. Use a coaching tone.
unnerf: Give each section the length the insight needs, and keep the whole summary readable in one screen. Do not overwhelm the user with detail that does not change their next step. Name no specific numerical stats and no underlined_categories from the session data below. Use a coaching tone.
